celfmt -i src.cel -o out1.cel
! stderr .
cmp out1.cel want.txt

# Verify idempotency.
celfmt -i out1.cel -o out2.cel
! stderr .
cmp out1.cel out2.cel

-- src.cel --
state.with(
	// Comment before a parenthesised receiver.
	(
		state.x
	).as(y, {"a": y})
)
-- want.txt --
state.with(
	// Comment before a parenthesised receiver.
	state.x.as(y, {"a": y})
)
